name: WorldLook
author: Dominik
description: Native sky with mild clock-weighted light and clear coastal water. Correct HHMM time conversion, one session toggle, and a small targeted status report. Water shader embedded in the DLL.
manualTrigger: Ctrl+Shift+F7 toggles light and water together for the session. Ctrl+Shift+F9 writes targeted state. Configuration is read on startup from UserData/WorldLook/WorldLook.json.
reportPath: UserData/WorldLook/status.json; ordinary state changes and errors in MelonLoader/Latest.log
limitations: Native sky/clouds/sun/moon/stars remain game-owned. Mild warmth peaks at 06:00 and 18:00, neutral at noon/night. Water targets only Main/Map/StylizedWater2_Ocean and needs camera depth/opaque input requests; those settings do not prove texture contents. Gameplay acceptance pending.
removal: With the game closed, remove Mods/WorldLook.dll and its optional PDB/metadata under UserData/WorldLook. Keep Shared. The old external s1reference.bundle belongs to the archived 0.1.x build.
